QuestInfo.name: Spiritual Release
QuestInfo.0: Princess Sakuno has contacted you. What could it be?
QuestInfo.1: Princess Sakuno has requested your presence in Momijigaoka. You're important!
QuestInfo.2: Princess Sakuno has noticed how awesome your Spirit Walker skills have become. She gave you a charm that was once used by her mother. It's bursting with mana.
